        How We Deliver
        
4-Stage Commissioning Workflow

      


      

        

          01
          
Site Audit & URS

          
Define I/O counts, safety interlocks, motor ratings, and communication topology before writing a single line of code.

        

        

          02
          
Siemens Logic & HMI

          
Write modular SCL/ST, LAD & FBD Function Blocks, configure SINAMICS drive telegrams, and build WinCC HMI/SCADA screens.

        

        

          03
          
PLCSIM & Loop Check

          
Simulate sequences in TIA Portal PLCSIM, then verify every field sensor, actuator, and E-Stop on-site before energizing drives.

        

        

          04
          
Commissioning & AMC

          
Full on-site dry-run, operator training, as-built documentation handover, and optional Annual Maintenance Contracts.
